column1: # Cases for the agent guard, fed through the real adapters by run-agent-guard-case.sh. One case per line, tab-separated:
#   name  tools  cwd  environment  expectation  input
# tools: <Claude tool>/<agy tool>; "-" skips that runtime. Bash and run_command take a command; the other tools a path.
# cwd: the directory of the call. environment: "-" (ARIADSHOT_MACSHOT_DIR set), "macshot-empty" (the variable is
# empty) or "no-jq" (jq is not on PATH). expectation: allow, or deny:<rule>, matched against the guard's own message.
# Placeholders: @WORK@ a repository on branch feat/maintenance with a local tag v0.1.0; @MAIN@ a repository on main;
# @MACSHOT@ a MacShot tree at @TMP@/reference/macshot, next to @WORK@ (@TMP@/work).

column6: gh api graphql -f query='mutation { mergePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
